content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests pass (desktop and phone). I fixed three CSS bugs in `site/css/styles.css`:

1. **Missing nav links:** `.navbar-nav` had `display: none`, so Home, About and Shop disappeared and the Cart button moved next to the brand. I set it back to `display: flex`.
2. **Left padding on phone:** `.px-4` had `padding-left: 2.25rem` while the right side was `1.5rem`. That pushed the content right and made the phone page 8px taller. I set the left side back to `1.5rem`.
3. **Shop dropdown arrow:** the arrow's left border was `0.45em`, which made it lopsided. I set it back to `0.3em`.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing against the approved screenshots rather than reading a diff of the last change. I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE

result:
The site matches the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests pass (desktop and phone). I fixed three CSS bugs in `site/css/styles.css`:

1. **Missing nav links:** `.navbar-nav` had `display: none`, so Home, About and Shop disappeared and the Cart button moved next to the brand. I set it back to `display: flex`.
2. **Left padding on phone:** `.px-4` had `padding-left: 2.25rem` while the right side was `1.5rem`. That pushed the content right and made the phone page 8px taller. I set the left side back to `1.5rem`.
3. **Shop dropdown arrow:** the arrow's left border was `0.45em`, which made it lopsided. I set it back to `0.3em`.

The repo has only one commit, so I found these by comparing against the approved screenshots rather than reading a diff of the last change. I didn't commit anything.
